Simple example function

Source: R/DemoApp.R
sum_step.Rd

This function is used in the demo workflows to demonstrate how to run a workflow step that performs a simple operation.

Usage

sum_step(lData, y)

Arguments

lData

list A named list of data objects. The function expects lData$value to be a numeric value.

y

numeric A numeric value to add to lData$value.

Value

numeric The result of adding y to lData$value.

Examples

sum_step(list(value = 5), 3)
#> [1] 8
